title: Audit text and artifact redistribution rights
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
rights.json and attribution.md are uncommitted working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status.
633 pinned README cards matched the inventory card sha256. Nine datasets have no pinned card and stay unresolved.
Three current Hub revisions differ from the inventory pin (endomorphosis/world_caselaw, world_municipal_law, world_national_law). Rights are bound to the inventory revision, not the later Hub head.
Organization membership in justicedao or endomorphosis is not a redistribution license. inferred_from_organization is false on every record.

A record is resolved only when its own pinned card states one dataset-wide grant and the attribution that grant requires. license: other, unquoted portal terms, hedged wording, per-source splits, and missing cards stay unresolved blockers.
44 records are resolved and 598 are unresolved. Unresolved rights block every artifact kind on that record.
Embeddings, indexes, and official translations are bound to the dataset that publishes them. They do not inherit a license from a sibling corpus.

Administrative boundary polygons and municipality geometry are not in the pinned inventory. That gap is an explicit blocker. OpenStreetMap courthouse locations are bound only on endomorphosis/world_courts (ODbL-1.0) and endomorphosis/ipfs_france_courts (unresolved).
The rights audit validates data/worldwide/rights.json. It does not execute a separate rights module and it does not load attribution.md.
